_comment: Template for local secrets. Copy this file to outbound/Secrets.json and fill in real values. outbound/Secrets.json is gitignored so keys never land in source control. It is bundled as an app resource (the outbound/ folder is a file-system-synchronized group, so the file is included automatically) and read at runtime by GooglePlacesClient. Restrict the key to bundle id earth.outbound + the Places API in the Google Cloud console.
